sentences.text: Pieris rapae, known as the Small White, is an insect in the order Lepidoptera.
In Mainz-Bingen, 576 reports have been logged in ten years, mostly from June to September, with most reports in August.
It has been recorded eating Red Clover, common dandelion, Rapeseed and Hawkweed Oxtongue, among other plants.
Goldenrod Crab Spider and House sparrow are recorded as predators.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Shepherd's-purse, Dewberry, Meadow Buttercup and Germander Speedwell.
